question.text: Which one of the following statements is not true about enzymes?

options.text: Enzymes are non-specific for a reaction and substrate.
Enzymes work as catalysts by lowering the activation energy of a biochemical reaction.
The action of enzymes is temperature and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>pH</mi></math> specific

solution.text: Enzymes are very specific in nature.
